strategies.description: The AI picks which source to check next, one at a time, and when to stop.
Check every source, then decide. The reference baseline.
Checklist order; stop as soon as the decision is no longer the fallback.
Checklist order; stop once the AI's top probability reaches the confidence threshold.
Decide from the request alone, without checking anything. The lower bound.

domains.title: Retail returns
domains.name: returns
domains.task: Resolve a customer's product return request.

sources.description: Retrieve the order record (delivery status, purchase age).
Retrieve the applicable return policy (window, requirements).

actions.meaning: Every requirement in the fetched policy is confirmed by fetched evidence.
Fetched evidence confirms a required policy condition is false.
Requirements are missing, unavailable or contradictory in the fetched evidence.

conditions.meaning: Fetched order evidence confirms the item was delivered.
Fetched order and policy evidence confirm purchase age is within the return window.
Fetched inspection evidence confirms the item is damaged.

domains.title: Insurance claims
domains.name: insurance_claims
domains.task: Triage a property insurance claim: pay it, deny it, or refer it to a human adjuster.

sources.description: Policy record: is coverage active and is this peril covered?
Claim history: prior claims and open fraud flags.
Adjuster report: is the loss verified and what is the assessed amount?

actions.meaning: Coverage is active, the peril is covered, the loss is verified and there is no fraud flag.
Evidence confirms the policy does not cover this claim or the loss did not happen.
Evidence is missing or conflicting, or a fraud flag needs a human adjuster.

conditions.meaning: The fetched policy record shows active coverage for this peril.
The fetched claim history shows no open fraud flag.
The fetched adjuster report verifies the loss.
